note: Battery cost index series used to normalize comparables to 2026 (research pass 2 Oct 2026; values from search-index excerpts of the publishers' releases, no interpolation by the researcher). adjust_model.py interpolates linearly between published points and holds series flat outside their span. Pack and turnkey are real dollars of each survey year; EIA and LBNL nominal; NREL as published; LCOS is $/MWh (a levelized, not capital, metric).

construction_index.label: Handy-Whitman North Atlantic, total steam production plant (July index, 1973 = 100), as posted by PJM
construction_index.conf: Medium (2015-2018 seen in excerpt; later years from search summary of the same posting); production-plant line, not distribution plant

installed.label: Installed all-in (EIA-860 2015-18, LBNL 2024)
installed.source: EIA Today in Energy #45596 (2015 $2,152; 2017 $834; 2018 $625); LBNL Utility-Scale Solar 2025 (2024 $458)

pack.label: BNEF pack price, as released (real $ of survey year)
pack.source: BloombergNEF Lithium-Ion Battery Price Survey releases 2014-2025

turnkey.label: BNEF turnkey system, global (4-h to 2023; all durations 2024-25)
turnkey.source: BloombergNEF Energy Storage System Cost Survey 2021-2025

nrel.label: NREL bottom-up 4-h 60 MW base year (2022 and 2024 editions)
nrel.source: NREL Cost Projections for Utility-Scale Battery Storage: 2023 update (2022 base $482, Ramasamy et al.) and 2025 update (2024 base $334)
nrel.conf: Medium; earlier editions' base years not retrieved (held flat before 2022)

lcos.label: Lazard LCOS midpoint, unsubsidized 100 MW 4-h
lcos.conf: Medium; v8.0 (2023) possibly conflated with 2024 and omitted
